bible.title: The Burn-List
bible.kernel: A merchant-matron hires the company to recover and destroy a stolen roll of names.

cast.name: Resetta Palebough
cast.who: a merchant-matron of the Western Forests who protects her house's standing.
cast.want: to recover and burn a list of names taken from her house

cast.name: Richelda the Younger
cast.who: a pale former librarian turned itinerant paleographer from the Western Forests.
cast.want: to sell copies of the list to the highest bidder

cast.name: Gurilda
cast.who: a forager born in Hemlock Glen who runs a wayside apothecary.
cast.want: payment and a tonic root for her sister

bible.situation: Resetta Palebough hires the company to recover a stolen roll of names she says was taken from her house and to destroy it before it reaches the guild court.
bible.goal: to recover and burn a list of names taken from Resetta Palebough's house.
arc: Search Palewater Crossing for signs of the lost roll the matron says was taken there → yields: Gedsar the ferryman says a pale scholar, Richelda the Younger, left the crossing for Hemlock Glen and left a scrap marked with her name.

Track Richelda into Hemlock Glen and question the local herbalist for a lead using the ferryman's sighting → yields: Gurilda appears, refuses to touch the matter for free, and points to the old gatehouse at Bramble Hollow as Richelda's hide.
Bring Richelda from the Bramble Hollow gatehouse back to Palewater Crossing and hand the roll to Resetta Palebough, while Richelda resists and is captured by force, cunning, or coin
bible.twist: The list names the people Resetta's house has blackmailed and records the bribes they paid.
tensions: a squeamish herbalist who will not accept blood and exacts a costly favor
a sickly, hotheaded scholar who will resist capture and prefers coin to threats
river crossings watched by wary ferrymen who trade information for safety
openDirections: If the list is shown the guild court will convene and rival houses will press claims on Resetta's routes.
bible.stakeIfLost: Resetta says her merchant charter will be voided if the list reaches the guild court, letting rival houses seize her trade routes.
bible.arrival: crossed the river to get here · would not name the place until the terms were set

shipped.title: Search Palewater Crossing
shipped.situation: A merchant-matron, Resetta Palebough, crossed the river to get here and would not name the place until terms were set. She laughs in the wrong place as she says she wants us to search Palewater Crossing for the lost roll, the fee is as agreed, and any spoils ride home with it. Resetta says her merchant charter will be voided if the list reaches the guild court, letting rival houses seize her trade routes. A scholar means to sell copies of the list to the highest bidder. The crossing's paths pass the ruined gatehouse, Bramble Hollow gatehouse, which swallows tracks and hides traces of passing hands.
shipped.job: Search Palewater Crossing for signs of the lost roll the matron says was taken there.
